findings.description: Lucia Skora's parents were Antonius Skora and Elisabeth Skrownionka, named on her baptism at Przecław on 13 November 1807.
supporting_sources: Poland, Tarnow, Roman Catholic Diocese Church Books, 1612-1900 — baptism of Lucia Skora, Przecław, 13 Nov 1807, daughter of Antonius Skora and Elisabeth Skrownionka
